partially_covered.missing: No explicit data properties for organization details (e.g., contact info, legal entity type, etc.)
No explicit SHACL or OWL restrictions enforcing D96A/EN 16931-1 required fields; only some cardinality constraints present

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are directly supported by the class/property structure. CQ5 and CQ13 are only partially addressed due to missing fine-grained organization attributes and lack of explicit constraints for mandatory fields.

strengths: Comprehensive use of object/data property characteristics
Good use of reification for organization roles in invoice context
Disjointness and disjointUnion for key structural classes
weaknesses: No GCAs or equivalentClass axioms for complex concepts
Limited enrichment of organization and item attributes
No SHACL or OWL-based validation for mandatory data fields

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7 (Missing domain/range for some inverses if not explicitly declared)
P28 (Potential lack of explicit inverse functional for some identifiers)

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit data properties for organization details (e.g., name, legal form, contact info) to fully answer CQ5.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables full retrieval of organization information as required by the scenario.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add OWL restrictions or SHACL shapes to enforce mandatory fields as per D96A and EN 16931-1 (e.g., invoice number, buyer GLN, total amount).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables automated validation and compliance with standards (CQ13).

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Define General Class Axioms (GCAs) or owl:equivalentClass for key concepts (e.g., BuyerOrganizationRole as an OrganizationRoleInInvoice with hasRole Buyer).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves reasoning and query expressiveness for roles.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Enrich Item and Organization classes with additional attributes (e.g., product codes, organization type).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves descriptive power and supports more detailed queries.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add more examples and rdfs:seeAlso links to external ontologies (e.g., P2P-O, EN 16931-1 URIs).

summary: The ontology provides a strong structural foundation for UN/EDIFACT invoice modeling, with robust class and property hierarchies and correct use of reification for organizational roles. Most competency questions are well-covered, though explicit organization attributes and mandatory field constraints are lacking. Quality is high, but further enrichment and validation constraints are recommended for full scenario compliance.
